mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_user) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_profile_summary) AS profiledUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_segment WHERE segment_code = 'HIGH_VALUE') AS highValueUsers, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_payment_amount), 0) FROM user_profile_summary) AS totalPaymentAmount
SELECT segment_code AS segmentCode, segment_name AS segmentName, COUNT(*) AS userCount FROM user_segment GROUP BY segment_code, segment_name ORDER BY userCount DESC

SELECT t.tag_code AS tagCode, ut.tag_value AS tagValue, COUNT(DISTINCT ut.user_id) AS userCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ut.user_id) / totals.total_count AS userRatio FROM user_profile_tag ut JOIN profile_tag_definition t ON t.id = ut.tag_id JOIN (SELECT tag_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS total_count FROM user_profile_tag GROUP BY tag_id) totals ON totals.tag_id = ut.tag_id WHERE (#{tagCode} IS NULL OR t.tag_code = #{tagCode}) GROUP BY t.tag_code, ut.tag_value, totals.total_count ORDER BY t.tag_code, userCount DESC

mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS userId, u.user_code AS userCode, u.gender, u.age, u.province, u.city, COALESCE(p.total_order_count, 0) AS totalOrderCount, COALESCE(p.total_payment_amount, 0) AS totalPaymentAmount, s.segment_code AS segmentCode, s.segment_name AS segmentName, s.segment_score AS segmentScore
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.total_payment_amount, 0) DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.user_code AS userCode, u.gender, u.age, u.province, u.city, COALESCE(p.total_order_count, 0) AS totalOrderCount, COALESCE(p.total_payment_amount, 0) AS totalPaymentAmount, COALESCE(p.average_order_amount, 0) AS averageOrderAmount, COALESCE(p.browse_count_30d, 0) AS browseCount30d, COALESCE(p.login_count_30d, 0) AS loginCount30d, p.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, s.segment_code AS segmentCode, s.segment_name AS segmentName, s.segment_score AS segmentScore FROM ecommerce_user u LEFT JOIN user_profile_summary p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_segment s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}

SELECT ORDER BY COALESCE(ps.total_payment_amount, 0) DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT u.gender AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u WHERE u.id IN #{id} GROUP BY u.gender

SELECT CASE WHEN u.age BETWEEN 0 AND 17 THEN '0-17' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN '18-24' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 25 AND 30 THEN '25-30' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31-40' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '41-50' ELSE '50+' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u WHERE u.id IN #{id} GROUP BY label ORDER BY MIN(u.age)
SELECT COALESCE(sg.segment_name, '未分层') AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u LEFT JOIN user_segment sg ON sg.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id IN #{id} GROUP BY sg.segment_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT '平均客单价' AS label, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ps.total_payment_amount), 2), 0) AS avgPayment, COALESCE(SUM(ps.total_payment_amount), 0) AS totalPayment, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u LEFT JOIN user_profile_summary ps ON ps.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id IN #{id}

SELECT ut.tag_value AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT ut.user_id) AS cnt FROM user_profile_tag ut JOIN profile_tag_definition td ON td.id = ut.tag_id AND td.tag_code = 'FAVORITE_CATEGORY' WHERE ut.user_id IN #{id} GROUP BY ut.tag_value ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
